environment.description: Lambda function URL with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The function URL resource policy specifies a Condition block with StringEquals on lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType set to AWS_IAM, and the Principal is restricted to a specific IAM role ARN (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/TaskCLIAuthorizedRole). Unsigned requests receive HTTP 403 before reaching the Lambda runtime. The Envoy sidecar configuration includes a header_mutation filter in the HTTP connection manager that removes any inbound metadata key matching the regex pattern '^x-auth-.*' before forwarding to the upstream gRPC service cluster. CloudWatch Logs Insights query scheduled every 5 minutes alerts on metadata injection patterns but does NOT block them.
